offer.text: The flock's been stubborn at shearing time. Bring me 12 wool and I'll make it worth the trouble.

accept.text: Mind the sheep — they bite when they're cross.

decline.text: Suit yourself. The looms can wait.

ready.text: Soft and clean — just what I needed. Let's settle up.

complete.text: The whole village will be warmer for this.
